services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.24-alpine
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    volumes:
      - ./public:/var/www/portal/public:ro
      - ./.docker/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on:
      - app
  app:
    image: registry.internal/platform/portal:1.8.4
    working_dir: /var/www/portal
    env_file: .env
    depends_on:
      - mysql
      - redis
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: portal
      MYSQL_USER: portal
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: w4K8nQ2tR7pM5vX9
    volumes:
      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
volumes:
  mysql-data:
